page_title: STR 3-1 REI | Strasbourg v Reims 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Willy Delajod has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Aboubacar Ali Abdallah displays great vision and sends a pass to Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:1.
90+2' Oumar Diakite (Reims) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
90+1' Reims will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Reims have a goal ruled out for offside!
86' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Jessy Deminguet (Strasbourg) replaces Dilane Bakwa.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch for Ibrahima Sissoko.
83' None of the Strasbourg players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
82' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
80' The manager makes a subsitution with Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) coming on for Reda Khadra.
79' Yellow card. Amir Richardson (Reims) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
79' Substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) on for Keito Nakamura.
77' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) replacing Abakar Sylla.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jeremy Sebas departs the field of play to be replaced by Aboubacar Ali Abdallah (Strasbourg).
75' Reims fail to score from a corner as Alaa Bellaarouch (Strasbourg) leaps to collect the ball.
72' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
68' Reims are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
65' Ball possession – 45:55.
62' Will Still has decided to substitute Junya Ito and he is replaced by Therence Koudou (Reims).
62' It will be a substitution. Sergio Akieme (Reims) is ready to enter the pitch as Thomas Foket walks off.
61' Some patient build-up play from Strasbourg as they look to unlock the defence.
58' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
57' Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
56' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Thomas Delaine (Strasbourg) inside the box.
54' Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul after Thibault De Smet (Reims) hacks down one of his opponents.
52' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

50' 2 - 1 Superbly taken set piece! Dilane Bakwa takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) flicks the ball lightly with his head under the goalkeeper's legs. Yehvann Diouf can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 2:1.
49' Strasbourg are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
49' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+6' RED CARD! Amadou Kone (Reims) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Willy Delajod. He can have an early bath.
45+5' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45+3' Yehvann Diouf (Reims) produces a long-range pass.
45' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 1 Goal! Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Yehvann Diouf into the bottom left corner.
43' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

43' Referee Willy Delajod sees the trip by Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Strasbourg.
40' Habib Diarra is being substituted because of an injury. Patrick Vieira sends Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) on the pitch.
39' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Reims.
37' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
34' Oumar Diakite (Reims) has a goal ruled out for offside!
33' Junya Ito (Reims) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
33' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
28' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
28' What was Amadou Kone (Reims) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
26' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) manages a fine header towards goal, but it misses the target as the ball flies past the left post.
24' Lucas Perrin (Strasbourg) and Ibrahima Sissoko matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
23' Will Still is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) suffers an injury and Amadou Kone comes on.
21' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
19' The game is interrupted now, Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

16' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom right corner, but Yehvann Diouf makes a nice save.
15' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Strasbourg out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
14' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Reims seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

7' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Junya Ito finds Keito Nakamura (Reims), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Alaa Bellaarouch had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.
4' Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
3' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
3' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Strasbourg will kick the game off.
Willy Delajod will referee today's match.
